data.decision: Create a new top-level component krebs/ to own the canonical ticket-lifecycle spec, ticket-provider adapters, webhook normalization/fan-out, and observability.
data.reasoning: Lifecycle state machine, provider abstraction, and webhook fan-out were scattered across momo/skill/, per-repo _bmad/custom/workflows/, and ad-hoc tp adapters. Centralizing them under krebs/ gives one SSOT (spec/lifecycle.v1.yaml), a Strategy-pattern provider layer, and Bloodbank-normalized events. Momo consumes the spec from krebs; mcp-hub will expose krebs domains.
